title: Return of the Ruby
description: A New Armor and Tool Set To Use As A Alternative To Diamonds and A New Villager Profession
body:
A New Ore Found In Stone Is Waiting...
New Armor!
New Tools!
A New Job Block For Villagers!
A New Villager Profession: The Ruby Collector
The ruby collector can give rare items in exchange for rubies, such as: Banner Patterns, Music Discs, TOTEMS?! and more!
